behalf.zh: on behalf of / on one's behalf：代表（某人）、為了（某人）

ex.en: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
ex.zh: 我代表公司歡迎您。

ex.en: Please say hello to your family on my behalf.
ex.zh: 請代我向你的家人問好。

ex.en: I thank you on behalf of my son.
ex.zh: 我代表我兒子向您道謝。

ex.en: They sat on a park bench and began talking.
ex.zh: 他們坐在公園的長椅上，談起了話來。

ex.en: Tom sat on that park bench for nearly three hours.
ex.zh: 湯姆在公園的長椅上坐了將近三個小時。

ex.en: He and his friend sat on the bench.
ex.zh: 他和朋友坐在長椅上。

ex.en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
ex.zh: 請事先告訴我行程。

ex.en: In case I can't come, I'll give you a call beforehand.
ex.zh: 萬一我不能來，我會事先打電話給你。

ex.en: It had been arranged beforehand.
ex.zh: 那件事已經事先安排好了。

ex.en: What's your favorite way to cook beans?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡用什麼方式煮豆子？

ex.en: Chocolate is made from cocoa beans.
ex.zh: 巧克力是用可可豆做的。

ex.en: Brazil supplies the world with coffee beans of quality.
ex.zh: 巴西向全世界供應優質咖啡豆。

ex.en: I'm still a beginner.
ex.zh: 我還是個新手。

ex.en: This book is a good guide for beginners.
ex.zh: 這本書是很適合初學者的入門書。

ex.en: Tom's a beginner, but he catches on fast.
ex.zh: 湯姆是新手，但他學得很快。

ex.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
ex.zh: 規律運動有益健康。

ex.en: Walking is beneficial.
ex.zh: 走路對身體有益。

ex.en: The agreement is beneficial to both companies.
ex.zh: 這份協議對雙方公司都有利。

ex.en: The app is still in beta.
ex.zh: 這個 App 還在測試階段。

ex.en: Sign up to test the beta version.
ex.zh: 報名試用測試版。

ex.en: Alpha, beta and gamma are Greek letters.
ex.zh: α、β 和 γ 都是希臘字母。

ex.en: Beta is the second letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.zh: β 是希臘字母的第二個字母。

ex.en: She thinks that happiness and health should be the benchmarks for success.
ex.zh: 她認為快樂與健康才是衡量成功的標準。

ex.en: This product has become the industry benchmark.
ex.zh: 這項產品已成為業界的標竿。

benchmark.zh: 以…為基準比較、做標竿評比

ex.en: We benchmark our prices against our competitors.
ex.zh: 我們以競爭對手為基準來比較價格。

ex.en: The team benchmarked the new software for speed.
ex.zh: 團隊對新軟體做了速度評比測試。

ex.en: She is the sole beneficiary of the insurance policy.
ex.zh: 她是這張保單唯一的受益人。

ex.en: Small businesses are the main beneficiaries of the new law.
ex.zh: 小型企業是新法的主要受惠者。

ex.en: The study looks at consumer behavioral patterns.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討消費者的行為模式。

ex.en: Behavioral changes take time.
ex.zh: 行為改變需要時間。

ex.en: Beef is usually more expensive than pork.
ex.zh: 牛肉通常比豬肉貴。

ex.en: Would you like some more beef?
ex.zh: 你要再來點牛肉嗎？

ex.en: I asked you to buy beef, not pork.
ex.zh: 我是叫你買牛肉，不是豬肉。

ex.en: We need to beef up security at the entrance.
ex.zh: 我們需要加強入口的保全。

ex.en: The company is beefing up its online marketing.
ex.zh: 公司正在加強網路行銷。

ex.en: I'm checking for laser beam alarm triggers.
ex.zh: 我在檢查有沒有雷射光束警報裝置。

ex.en: A beam of sunlight came through the window.
ex.zh: 一道陽光從窗戶照了進來。

ex.en: The old house has wooden beams on the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子的天花板上有木頭橫梁。

ex.en: The workers lifted a steel beam into place.
ex.zh: 工人把鋼梁吊到定位。

ex.en: She beamed with pride at her son's graduation.
ex.zh: 她在兒子的畢業典禮上驕傲地笑開了。

ex.en: He beamed when he heard the good news.
ex.zh: 他聽到好消息時笑得合不攏嘴。

be.zh: 是（連接主詞與身分、狀態）

ex.en: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
ex.zh: 我在你這個年紀時，冥王星還是行星。

ex.en: How could I be a robot? Robots don't dream.
ex.zh: 我怎麼可能是機器人？機器人不會做夢。

ex.en: The meeting room is on the third floor.
ex.zh: 會議室在三樓。

ex.en: Where was Tom last night?
ex.zh: 湯姆昨晚在哪裡？

ex.en: My manager is working on the new design.
ex.zh: 我的主管正在處理新的設計。

ex.en: The report was written by my manager.
ex.zh: 這份報告是我主管寫的。

ex.en: The company is going to launch the product next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月要推出這項產品。

ex.en: Is it going to rain this afternoon?
ex.zh: 今天下午會下雨嗎？

ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.
ex.zh: 你必須在截止日期前完成這項工作。

ex.en: You are always to knock before entering my room.
ex.zh: 進我房間前一定要先敲門。

ex.en: It won't be long before we know the truth.
ex.zh: 真相很快就會揭曉。

ex.en: Turn off the lights before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請關燈。

ex.en: You've been late for school more often than before.
ex.zh: 你上學遲到的次數比以前更多了。

ex.en: I've seen this movie before.
ex.zh: 我以前看過這部電影。

ex.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
ex.zh: 飛機開始震動時，乘客都緊張了起來。

ex.en: The older we become, the worse our memory gets.
ex.zh: 我們年紀越大，記憶力就越差。

ex.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.
ex.zh: 那個窮苦的年輕人最後成為了偉大的藝術家。

ex.en: She became a manager last year.
ex.zh: 她去年升上經理。

ex.en: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
ex.zh: 如果我們早點開始，就能在午餐前完成。

ex.en: Mr Smith always begins his lectures with a joke.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生總是用笑話開始上課。

ex.en: The meeting will begin at nine.
ex.zh: 會議九點開始。

begin.zh: from beginning to end：從頭到尾

ex.en: I found this book interesting from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 我覺得這本書從頭到尾都很有趣。

ex.en: The concert was great from beginning to end.
ex.zh: 這場音樂會從頭到尾都很精彩。

ex.en: To begin with, let me explain the plan.
ex.zh: 首先，讓我說明一下計畫。

ex.en: To begin with, the price is too high.
ex.zh: 首先，價格太高了。

ex.en: I believed that he would keep his promise.
ex.zh: 我相信他會遵守諾言。

ex.en: I can't believe it!
ex.zh: 真不敢相信！

ex.en: He believes that there is a spy among us.
ex.zh: 他認為我們當中有一個間諜。

ex.en: It is believed that whales have their own language.
ex.zh: 一般認為鯨魚有自己的語言。

believe.zh: believe in：相信（…的存在或價值）

ex.en: I believe in hard work.
ex.zh: 我相信努力的價值。

ex.en: Do you believe in luck?
ex.zh: 你相信運氣嗎？

ex.en: Please bear with me until I finish the story.
ex.zh: 請耐心聽我把故事講完。

ex.en: I can't bear the noise from next door.
ex.zh: 我受不了隔壁的噪音。

ex.en: She couldn't bear to see him leave.
ex.zh: 她不忍心看他離開。

bear.zh: 承受（重量）；負擔（費用、責任）

ex.en: The ice is too thin to bear your weight.
ex.zh: 冰太薄，承受不了你的重量。

ex.en: The company will bear the cost of the repairs.
ex.zh: 公司將負擔維修費用。

ex.en: This tree bears good peaches every year.
ex.zh: 這棵樹每年都結出好吃的桃子。

ex.en: These trees bear fruit in late summer.
ex.zh: 這些樹在夏末結果。

ex.en: Please bear in mind that the office closes at five.
ex.zh: 請記得辦公室五點關門。

ex.en: Bear in mind that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請記住價格可能會變動。

ex.en: We saw a bear near the campsite.
ex.zh: 我們在營地附近看到一隻熊。

ex.en: Bears sleep through most of the winter.
ex.zh: 熊大部分的冬天都在冬眠。

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: He looked at the pine tree behind the house.
ex.zh: 他望向房子後面的那棵松樹。

ex.en: A strange sound was heard from behind the door.
ex.zh: 門後傳來奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: Our project is behind schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的專案進度落後。

ex.en: Sales are behind last year's numbers.
ex.zh: 銷售額落後去年的數字。

ex.en: What was the reason behind his decision?
ex.zh: 他做這個決定背後的原因是什麼？

ex.en: The whole team is behind you.
ex.zh: 整個團隊都支持你。

ex.en: We found the beds quite comfortable.
ex.zh: 我們覺得這些床很舒服。

ex.en: We have space for two beds.
ex.zh: 我們有空間放兩張床。

ex.en: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
ex.zh: 房間裡除了一張破舊的床，什麼都沒有。

ex.en: It is time for you to go to bed.
ex.zh: 你該去睡覺了。

ex.en: The boy went to bed with his socks on.
ex.zh: 那個男孩穿著襪子就上床睡覺了。

ex.en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
ex.zh: 你的行為造成了很多問題。

ex.en: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
ex.zh: 醫生持續觀察病人的行為。

ex.en: Some people felt that Tom's behavior was inappropriate.
ex.zh: 有些人覺得湯姆的行為不太恰當。

ex.en: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天低於零度。

ex.en: It is ten degrees below zero now.
ex.zh: 現在是零下十度。

ex.en: The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上氣溫降到零度以下。

ex.en: The sun has just sunk below the horizon.
ex.zh: 太陽剛沉到地平線下。

ex.en: Please sign below the line.
ex.zh: 請在線的下方簽名。

ex.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
ex.zh: 關於下面的內容，我想確認兩件事。

ex.en: Please see the details below.
ex.zh: 詳情請見下方。

ex.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
ex.zh: 巴黎是世界上最美的城市。

ex.en: The flowers will look more beautiful in the vase.
ex.zh: 這些花插在花瓶裡會更好看。

ex.en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，那座島非常美。

ex.en: The beauty of that country is beyond description.
ex.zh: 那個國家的美難以言喻。

ex.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
ex.zh: 這超出了我的想像。

ex.en: It is beyond my power to build my own house.
ex.zh: 自己蓋房子超出了我的能力。

ex.en: A beautiful lake lay just beyond the forest.
ex.zh: 森林的另一邊有一座美麗的湖。

ex.en: There is a small village beyond the hills.
ex.zh: 山丘的另一邊有一個小村莊。

ex.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
ex.zh: 我們必須團結起來才能打敗敵人。

ex.en: Our team beat them 3 to 1.
ex.zh: 我們隊以三比一打敗了他們。

ex.en: My heart beat when I heard my name called.
ex.zh: 聽到有人叫我的名字，我的心怦怦直跳。

ex.en: His heart stopped beating and he died immediately.
ex.zh: 他的心臟停止跳動，當場死亡。

ex.en: She was humming a song in four beats.
ex.zh: 她哼著一首四拍子的歌。

ex.en: This song has a great beat.
ex.zh: 這首歌的節奏很棒。

ex.en: This town has two beaches.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮有兩個海灘。

ex.en: He wanted to go to the beach with her.
ex.zh: 他想和她一起去海邊。

ex.en: Some beaches had failed to comply with environmental regulations.
ex.zh: 有些海灘沒有遵守環保法規。

ex.en: How do you know that belongs to Tom?
ex.zh: 你怎麼知道那是湯姆的？

ex.en: They said it belonged to them.
ex.zh: 他們說那是他們的。

ex.en: Which Buddhist school of thought do they belong to?
ex.zh: 他們屬於哪個佛教宗派？

ex.en: Put the books back where they belong.
ex.zh: 把書放回原位。

ex.en: I finally feel like I belong here.
ex.zh: 我終於覺得自己屬於這裡。

ex.en: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
ex.zh: 我堅信他是清白的。

ex.en: It's my belief that knowledge is power.
ex.zh: 我相信知識就是力量。

ex.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡量避免把自己的想法強加在別人身上。

ex.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
ex.zh: 她除了是演員，還是一位著名的畫家。

ex.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
ex.zh: 除了鋼琴，你還會彈其他樂器嗎？

ex.en: There was no one there besides me.
ex.zh: 那裡除了我，一個人都沒有。

ex.en: I don't want to go out. Besides, it's raining.
ex.zh: 我不想出門，而且外面在下雨。

ex.en: The hotel is too expensive. Besides, it's far from the station.
ex.zh: 那家飯店太貴了，而且離車站很遠。

ex.en: This place is famous for its scenic beauty.
ex.zh: 這個地方以風景優美聞名。

ex.en: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
ex.zh: 那裡的景色美得難以形容。

ex.en: She will be a beauty when she grows up.
ex.zh: 她長大後一定是個美女。

ex.en: His sister was a famous beauty.
ex.zh: 他姊姊是有名的美女。

ex.en: The beauty of this plan is that it's cheap.
ex.zh: 這個計畫的好處在於很便宜。

ex.en: The beauty of working from home is the flexibility.
ex.zh: 在家工作的好處是有彈性。

ex.en: I bet ten dollars on that horse.
ex.zh: 我在那匹馬上押了十美元。

ex.en: I made a bet that she would win the game.
ex.zh: 我跟人打賭她會贏得比賽。

ex.en: I bet he will get mad.
ex.zh: 我敢說他一定會生氣。

ex.en: I bet Tom and Mary have never even been to Boston.
ex.zh: 我敢說湯姆和瑪麗根本沒去過波士頓。

ex.en: I lost the bet and had to buy lunch.
ex.zh: 我打賭輸了，只好請吃午餐。

ex.en: They made a bet on the game.
ex.zh: 他們拿那場比賽打賭。

ex.en: Two beers, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩杯啤酒。

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天喝生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: I've just eaten some sushi and drunk a beer.
ex.zh: 我剛吃了壽司，喝了一杯啤酒。

ex.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?
ex.zh: 你受得了他的行為舉止嗎？

ex.en: He is very much ashamed of having behaved so badly.
ex.zh: 他為自己表現得那麼差勁感到非常羞愧。

ex.en: My computer is behaving strangely.
ex.zh: 我的電腦怪怪的。

ex.en: Please behave yourself at the party.
ex.zh: 在派對上請守規矩。

ex.en: The children behaved well during the trip.
ex.zh: 孩子們在旅途中都很乖。

ex.en: She bent down and picked up the coin.
ex.zh: 她彎下腰把硬幣撿起來。

ex.en: He has back pain, he can't bend over.
ex.zh: 他背痛，沒辦法彎腰。

ex.en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
ex.zh: 我不用彎膝蓋就能把手掌平貼在地上。

ex.en: Tom took the bend too fast and landed in the ditch.
ex.zh: 湯姆轉彎轉得太快，衝進了水溝。

ex.en: There's a sharp bend in the road ahead.
ex.zh: 前方道路有個急彎。

ex.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.
ex.zh: 他費盡心思討好老婆。

ex.en: The staff bent over backwards to help us.
ex.zh: 員工們竭盡全力幫助我們。

ex.en: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
ex.zh: 那些錢藏在地板下面。

ex.en: We sat beneath a big tree to rest.
ex.zh: 我們坐在一棵大樹下休息。

ex.en: The ground beneath our feet began to shake.
ex.zh: 我們腳下的地面開始搖晃。

ex.en: The belt became a symbol of fear for me.
ex.zh: 那條皮帶成了我恐懼的象徵。

ex.en: These pants are too big; I need a belt.
ex.zh: 這條褲子太大了，我需要一條皮帶。

ex.en: Drivers should wear seat belts.
ex.zh: 駕駛應該繫安全帶。

ex.en: Fasten your seat belt at all times.
ex.zh: 請隨時繫好安全帶。

belt.zh: tighten one's belt：勒緊褲帶、節省開支

ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
ex.zh: 中小企業必須勒緊褲帶才能生存。

ex.en: We need to tighten our belts this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年得勒緊褲帶。

ex.en: The bell rang and the train moved off.
ex.zh: 鈴聲一響，火車就開動了。

ex.en: In case of fire, ring the bell.
ex.zh: 萬一發生火災，請按鈴。

ex.en: The school bell rings at eight.
ex.zh: 學校的鐘聲八點會響。

ex.en: The name rang a bell in me.
ex.zh: 這名字聽起來很耳熟。

ex.en: His name rings a bell, but I can't remember his face.
ex.zh: 他的名字聽起來很耳熟，但我想不起他的長相。

ex.en: What's your favorite beverage?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡的飲料是什麼？

ex.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

ex.en: What beverages do you like to drink?
ex.zh: 你喜歡喝什麼飲料？

ex.en: Our house has three bedrooms.
ex.zh: 我們家有三間臥室。

ex.en: The bedrooms are upstairs.
ex.zh: 臥室在樓上。

ex.en: Is there a television set in your bedroom?
ex.zh: 你臥室裡有電視嗎？

ex.en: Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.
ex.zh: 這本書是暢銷書。

ex.en: The new model became a bestseller within a month.
ex.zh: 這款新機上市一個月內就成了暢銷商品。

ex.en: We are behind schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的進度落後了。

ex.en: They're 30 minutes behind schedule.
ex.zh: 他們比預定時間落後了 30 分鐘。

ex.en: The bus was behind schedule.
ex.zh: 公車誤點了。

ex.en: There are lots of benefits from travelling abroad.
ex.zh: 去國外旅行有很多好處。

ex.en: Does doing things in this way have a benefit?
ex.zh: 這麼做有什麼好處嗎？

ex.en: This event benefits no one.
ex.zh: 這件事對誰都沒有好處。

ex.en: Who benefits from it?
ex.zh: 這對誰有好處？

ex.en: The company offers good benefits, including health insurance.
ex.zh: 這家公司福利很好，包括健康保險。

ex.en: Benefits include paid leave and an annual bonus.
ex.zh: 福利包括帶薪假和年終獎金。
